generate_benchmark_shell_scripts: run the script to generate bash scripts for RobustMVD benchmark experiments across models and datasets
generate_shell_for_single_experiment: generate a bash shell script for a single MVS benchmark experiment with specified model and dataset
get_model_settings: get model-specific configuration settings including pretrained path and evaluation resolution for a given model
generate_single_view_metric_experiments: generate benchmark shell scripts for single view metric experiments on kitti and scannet datasets
generate_multi_view_metric_experiments: generate benchmark shell scripts for multi view metric experiments with various conditioning options
